description: Orders of the circle's marketplace (read API GET /orders). With a hash: one order with its parties, budget, milestones and status. Without a hash: a page of orders, filtered by party and status. Use x207_search_listings to find offers before an order exists. An unknown hash is an error ("no order ... in circle"); an empty list is a normal result. Needs the read API (X207_BACKEND_URL).

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page; listing only.

hash.description: The order hash. Leave out to list orders.

party.description: Only orders where this account is buyer or seller (listing only).

status.description: Only orders in this state, e.g. open, delivered or disputed (listing only).

name: x207_order_status
title: Order status
